annotation.kind: source selection, tier label, and exact finite-restart strengthening of Theorem 6.3

assumptions: The dimension factor and both unit-roundoff parameters are nonnegative.
The mixed-precision factor Lambda = c*uLow*kappaF(A) is strictly less than one.
At each restart, backward error contracts by Lambda whenever it remains above the high-precision backward floor.
At each restart, forward error contracts by Lambda whenever it remains above the high-precision forward floor.
Ainv is supplied as the inverse representative used to form the Frobenius condition-number factor.

conditions.L: The identical fixed statement and P16 shared files are present; the frozen NumStability library is also present.
conditions.N: The fixed statement and P16 shared files are present; no NumStability artifact is present.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p16_t3_mixed_precision_geometric_convergence {n : Nat} (A Ainv : P16Matrix n) (c uLow uHigh : Real) (backwardError forwardError : Nat -> Real) ... : 0 <= p16BackwardFloor c uHigh and 0 <= p16ForwardFloor c uHigh A Ainv and forall i, p16MixedContraction c uLow A Ainv ^ i <= 1 and ...
formal_statement.plain_language: For every finite run of consecutive above-floor restarts, the mixed-precision backward and forward errors are bounded by Lambda to the number of restarts times their initial values.

informal_proof: Prove the Frobenius condition factor, contraction factor, and attainable floors are nonnegative. Use Lambda < 1 to bound every power by one, then induct on the restart count and apply the conditional contraction at the final step.
informal_statement: Exact finite interpretation of Theorem 6.3's claim that mixed-precision restarted GMRES contracts by Lambda until it reaches the high-precision attainable floors.

review_record_not_for_run_prompt.note: The frozen baseline can certify nonnegativity of the Frobenius condition factor, but searches of all 24 mounted modules found no GMRES, restarted-GMRES, mixed-precision convergence, or conditional geometric-until-floor theorem.

tier_rationale: The frozen library contributes only the primitive Frobenius nonnegativity used for the condition factor. The task adds the paper-specific mixed-precision floors, conditional restart semantics, and a finite Lambda-power induction absent from every mounted module.
